patch_description:
The current program replaced parametrized CRZ gates with fixed CZ gates and added RY reuse, which degraded performance from 0.91 to 0.87. The prior high-scoring programs (0.91) used parametrized CRZ in the reverse chain for enhanced expressivity.

This edit restores the proven CRZ reverse chain and adds a mid-circuit RZ phase flexibility stage immediately after the forward CZ chain by reusing the existing "rz_pre_a" and "rz_pre_b" parameters. This provides extra phase control without adding new parameters, bridging the expressivity gap without the computational cost of entirely new parameters.

The RY reuse at the end is removed as it appears to create redundancy rather than meaningful additional expressivity.
